title: Can Explainable Al Explain Unfairness? A Framework for Evaluating Explainable Al
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to this topic. The study focuses on evaluating XAI tools' capabilities to explain fairness and bias, using the COMPAS dataset which is known for racial and gender bias.

measurement_description: Not applicable. The paper's framework is designed to evaluate explainable AI (XAI) tools on their ability to detect and address issues of bias and fairness in general, without a specific focus on faith or religion.
